text:
hiya micka , you are always welcome to share your artistic charts

i my self try to trade in the extremes of a PAZ, and some times i miss
nice entries also , but it worth it . about your chart if i understood
correct from what you did , your answer is why price don't reach to that
 important DP then fall or rally .

generally price goes from FL to FL and we must understand the value of
FLs and i am still working on it . but you know that there are a lot of
DPs in the chart that the decision made to break a barrier in them but
price ignore them in his wy up or down , it has some reasons :

1- we need to know where did price come from ?

what does this question mean ?

ok , it means : is price coming from a HTF S/D zone ?if yes (assume
price come from daily SZ), then price can break all the barriers in the
way down , and we should not expect big reaction in those DPs, so this
is why RTM says always trade in the direction of major ENG.

2-we need to know if there is any better true S/D above or below our S/D
 zone or not ? (DP, when i say DP don't mean all DP or some thing like
this , i mean true S/D with a tricks that played in there in past )

3-we should imagine ITs mind , as Gil told we should wear ITs hat in our
 head to be ready for future tricks that are always will happen against
retailers some times with few pips just to hit Stops and you know the
rest of scenario sure ....

4- i am new , yes i am new to this method so as IF says always draw you zones and always trade in that areas,

5- as PED say looking at PA is always better and if i TT it means i am a bit lazy to wait for confirmation .

6- when a important DP(again please don't look at DPs as origin of break
 or something like that , i mean true supply and demand) ignore then
price get importance in the value in return and making FTR ,

7- don't look at patterns at all , all patterns have defined target before they form (in RT)

CAN CAN is FL ENG- RT in CP to FL

QM is FL ENG-RT to FL

CP is taking out demands in the way up to a true supply(FL) and after
entering to the CP paz( ENG of a FL in LTF )we can trade in RT(again to
FL ) to the target the extreme edge of CP(again FL)

Diamond is FL ENG before reaching the HH to true supply -RT and active STOPs ( FOed to true supply(again FL))

and all others formation of price action have defined target and entry
zone , we just need to open a chart and try to find real PA signals not
all of them .

in the case of your charts :

we need more details , believe me or not i my self for a trade need 4 H
TF in very left to now to 5 MIN TF at least to find a proper interest
area

hope it helps

Ok i see... Here are my doubts though..(something i'm not sure i fully understand)...

So , in this example , it reaches the FL (even breaks it). So we can
look for shorts at the FTB. But can price still fake out as far as
untouched MPL / decision though ?

And if so , wouldn't the R/R be too wide ?

For me , a safe top/high , is one that is already reacting from a decision point.

But from what you posted , it's ok even if it just breaks/fakes a fl
without touching the true supply. (as long as it keeps price down and
breaks the opposite fl for a potential FTB).

So both trades are safe then ? (i'm talking about the bearish trade opportunity).. For me , the safest is the FO to true demand.

Ok so , price then as to go the next PAZ. and once it does (if it still
doesn't reach true demand , it will travel back up , and either consume
or break/react to the bearish fl above , then travel finally back to
True demand and price is free to go to the decision above right ?

Btw , are we on the same page ? What you call "TRUE" demand . is the
Green decision i put on my chart right ? (would you consider that as
true demand ?)

author: salivan
text:
ok , FL is true S/D , and those DPs that are in FL in LTF are again FL
 , just it's need to look at it in different scales . it's about scale.

about shorting there , we know that prior opposite FL engulfed so we
know price wants higher , the safest entry is waiting for that true
demand to go long , no shorting , but some times i like it to short also
 in LTF PA confirmation .

the space between two FLs is a paz that blue rectangle was the extreme
edge of the paz that we waited for trade opp to buy , and yes price is
free to go to the DP above .

 mean that if i'm trading on the 4h (for ex) , waiting there for true

4h , that's a different scale though right ? (even though it's useful
for precise entries)
